timer.fullDomainProof: For uint32 t=100q+r, 0<=r<100: ceil((1000t)/100000)=q+[r!=0]. Both expressions fit before adding the same uint32 ms offset. No rounding or wrap state changes.

matrix.scope: Raw input supplied after GPIO collection; both images execute their linked timer and debounce code at identical controlled 100kHz ticks. CPU runtime is not modeled.

actions.scope: Linked timer, post-GPIO debounce, action_exec, layer and modifier processing. Identical row/column event order supplied by harness; EEPROM reads, LED output and host report sinks are modeled. USB transfer and OS interpretation are excluded.
